read.title: December Content Plan Draft
read.text:
Hi all,

Here is the draft of our December content calendar. Let's focus on two themes: winter dryness and holiday gift sets. Since short videos are our strongest format, we will post three Reels and one carousel each week, which raises our posting frequency from three to four posts.

I'd also like to try something new. How about inviting followers to share their winter routines? We could repost the best ones every Friday.

Please leave your comments by Tuesday.

Minsu

write.task: 다음 달 SNS 콘텐츠 계획을 팀에 공유해야 해요. 주제 하나와 주력 포맷을 정하고, 새 아이디어 하나를 제안하는 메시지를 써 보세요.
write.en: Share next month's social content plan with your team: one theme, the main format, and one new idea.
write.model:
Hi team,

For next month's content calendar, let's focus on hydration tips for dry skin. Short videos will be our main format, and we will post four times a week. How about starting a weekly 'Ask Our Chemist' series? I think it would build trust with our followers.

Minsu
